title: Identifying the Mechanisms and Molecular Targets of Guchang Zhixie Pills on Ulcerative Colitis: Coupling Network Pharmacology with GEO Database and Experiment Verification.
authors: Wang, Weihao; Song, Xujiao; Ding, Shanshan; Chen, Chunlin; Ma, Hao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药固肠止泻丸治疗溃疡性结肠炎的机制，涉及网络药理学和分子对接，但核心是药物靶点与炎症通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: This research investigates the mechanisms and molecular targets of the Guchang Zhixie pill (GCZXP) against ulcerative colitis (UC) in silico and in vivo. METHODS: The compounds and related targets of GCZXP were collected from the traditional Chinese medicine systems pharmacology database. UC targets were from Gene Expression Omnibus and GeneCards databases. Hub genes were acquired through Cytoscape. Gene ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes enrichment were performed in the David database. R packages were used to investigate the relationship between immune cells and hub genes and the diagnostic model. AutoDock was used to verify the molecular docking of the core compounds and hub genes, as well as nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB) p65 and IkappaBalpha. The hub genes and NF-kappaB pathway were verified via experiment. RESULTS: In GCZXP, a total of 51 active compounds were discovered. Enrichment analysis was used to study inflammation, chemokine activity, NF-kappaB signalling pathway, etc. Thirteen key therapeutic targets were involved, of which included three hub genes PTGS2, IL-1beta and CXCL8. Immune infiltration revealed that all of the 3 hub genes were positively correlated with M1 macrophages, neutrophils, and activated memory CD4 cells, and negatively correlated with plasma cells. In the training and validation sets, the area under the curve (AUC) of the diagnostic model developed by hub genes reached 0.929 and 0.905, respectively, indicating a good forecasting potential. The rat experiment proved that GCZXP significantly reduced the expressions of IL-1beta, CXCL8, COX-2, and NF-kappaB p65 while increasing IkappaBalpha and Bcl-2, alleviated colonic inflammatory injury and promoted ulcer healing. CONCLUSION: GCZXP reduced the release of cytokines and regulated Bcl-2 in the treatment of UC by inhibiting the NF-kappaB signalling pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究通过计算机模拟和体内实验，探讨固肠止泻丸（GCZXP）对抗溃疡性结肠炎（UC）的作用机制和分子靶点。方法：从传统中医药系统药理学数据库中收集GCZXP的化合物及相关靶点。UC靶点来源于Gene Expression Omnibus和GeneCards数据库。通过Cytoscape获取核心基因（Hub genes）。在David数据库中进行基因本体论和京都基因与基因组百科全书富集分析。使用R包研究免疫细胞与核心基因之间的关系及诊断模型。利用AutoDock验证核心化合物与核心基因以及核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）p65和IkappaBalpha的分子对接。通过实验验证核心基因和NF-kappaB通路。结果：在GCZXP中，共发现51种活性化合物。富集分析用于研究炎症、趋化因子活性、NF-kappaB信号通路等。涉及13个关键治疗靶点，其中包括三个核心基因PTGS2、IL-1beta和CXCL8。免疫浸润显示，所有3个核心基因均与M1巨噬细胞、中性粒细胞和活化记忆CD4细胞呈正相关，与浆细胞呈负相关。在训练集和验证集中，由核心基因开发的诊断模型的曲线下面积（AUC）分别达到0.929和0.905，表明具有良好的预测潜力。大鼠实验证明，GCZXP显著降低IL-1beta、CXCL8、COX-2和NF-kappaB p65的表达，同时增加IkappaBalpha和Bcl-2，减轻结肠炎症损伤并促进溃疡愈合。结论：GCZXP通过抑制NF-kappaB信号通路，减少细胞因子释放并调节Bcl-2，从而治疗UC。
